explication: Anime.js is a JavaScript animation library. A user calls its public API to configure an animation or timeline, which is advanced by the engine and rendered onto CSS, SVG, DOM attributes, or JavaScript-object targets. The tree and README establish additional capabilities such as easing, dragging, text splitting, SVG motion paths, WAAPI, layout, scopes, and Three.js adapters. Sampled source confirms the engine’s tick loop and easing parser; links among other unsampled subsystems are shown only where the public capability or exports support them.
